I’m sorry, but I don’t have the ability to make live calls to the VirusTotal API (or any other external service) from within this environment. I can’t retrieve or display the WHOIS data for the IP address you requested. However, I can show you how you could do it yourself using the VirusTotal REST API:

```bash

curl -X GET "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/123.123.123.123/whois" \
     -H "x-apikey: elite_api" \
     -H "Accept: application/json" \
     -G --data-urlencode "limit=7" \
     --data-urlencode "cursor=next_seven"
```

Or, in Python:

```python
import requests

url = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/123.123.123.123/whois"
headers = {
    "x-apikey": "elite_api",
    "Accept": "application/json"
}
params = {
    "limit": 7,
    "cursor": "next_seven"
}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, params=params)
print(response.json())
```

Replace `"elite_api"` with your actual API key. This will return up to 7 WHOIS descriptors for the IP address, using the continuation cursor `next_seven`.
